prompt.value: Imagine, you are an efficiency consultant hired by ABC Corp, a company that manufactures automotive parts. Your first assignment is to evaluate the performance of their primary production line. The provided data includes: ● The planned production time for last quarter was 700 hours. ● Unexpectedly, the line experienced 60 hours of lost time. ● The expected assembly rate of the line was 200 units per hour. ● However, the actual rate achieved was 180 units per hour. ● Over the quarter, 14,000 units were assembled. ● Out of these, 700 units were found to be defective. Calculate the OEE for ABC Corp's production line and provide the result.
